key: Changed How data cross references work. Any piece of data that needs to reference another piece of data should use the DataReference<T> type. In xml this is expressed in the following way: <ParentBody Ref="Sol" />. These References are now resolved at load previously there were a variety of adhoc approaches, most which involved some form of Get() command which ran a dictionary lookup.
english: Changed How data cross references work. Any piece of data that needs to reference another piece of data should use the DataReference<T> type. In xml this is expressed in the following way: <ParentBody Ref="Sol" />. These References are now resolved at load previously there were a variety of adhoc approaches, most which involved some form of Get() command which ran a dictionary lookup.
chinese: 调整数据交叉引用。引用其他数据时应使用 DataReference<T> 类型，XML 写法例如 <ParentBody Ref="Sol" />。引用现在在加载时解析。此前有多种临时做法，大多通过 Get() 一类调用查询字典。
notes: Translated from the installed 5801 changelog, keyed by the exact body text. Revision, date and author are rendered unchanged.

key: Changed How subpart data cross-references other subpart data. You now use the KeyReference<T> where T implements IKeyed. For example the Rocket Subpart of EngineALargeVacAssembly references its Core and Nozzle this way: <Core KeyRef="ThrustChamber" />. Sub Elements that need to be cross Referenced must implement IKeyed. These are resolved on load. The optional SubPart attribute should be used when the reference crosses to another template type e.g. Solid rocket motors FeedsFrom element.
english: Changed How subpart data cross-references other subpart data. You now use the KeyReference<T> where T implements IKeyed. For example the Rocket Subpart of EngineALargeVacAssembly references its Core and Nozzle this way: <Core KeyRef="ThrustChamber" />. Sub Elements that need to be cross Referenced must implement IKeyed. These are resolved on load. The optional SubPart attribute should be used when the reference crosses to another template type e.g. Solid rocket motors FeedsFrom element.
chinese: 调整子部件之间的数据引用。现在使用 KeyReference<T>，其中 T 实现 IKeyed。例如 EngineALargeVacAssembly 的 Rocket 子部件使用 <Core KeyRef="ThrustChamber" /> 引用其核心和喷管。需要被引用的子元素必须实现 IKeyed，引用在加载时解析。跨模板类型引用时可指定 SubPart，例如固体火箭发动机的 FeedsFrom 元素。

key: Added aerodynamic mesh generation. This is the first step in an improved aerodynamic simulation, for for the moment it doesn't affect the game. Every complete vehicle has a new mesh generated from its colliders (for now). Shapes which are far apart are meshed separately, while shapes that are close together or intersecting are remeshed as one watertight body using a voxelization and dual contouring method. The coarseness of the mesh is adjusted to keep the total number of panels below a certain threshold to avoid computational explosions in the future force solver.
english: Added aerodynamic mesh generation. This is the first step in an improved aerodynamic simulation, for for the moment it doesn't affect the game. Every complete vehicle has a new mesh generated from its colliders (for now). Shapes which are far apart are meshed separately, while shapes that are close together or intersecting are remeshed as one watertight body using a voxelization and dual contouring method. The coarseness of the mesh is adjusted to keep the total number of panels below a certain threshold to avoid computational explosions in the future force solver.
chinese: 新增气动网格生成，这是改进气动模拟的第一步，目前尚未影响玩法。暂时从每艘完整载具的碰撞体生成网格。相距较远的形状分别生成网格，相邻或相交的形状通过体素化和对偶轮廓法合成闭合网格。通过调整网格粗细控制面元总数，避免未来求解气动力时计算量激增。

key: Why it happened: the reflog shows a rebase onto origin/main right after I staged commit 1. If you update after staging, let me know and I'll check the index before
english: Why it happened: the reflog shows a rebase onto origin/main right after I staged commit 1. chinese: 原因：reflog 显示我暂存提交 1 后立即变基到 origin/main。Rider 更新前暂存未提交的工作，更新后再恢复，恢复时撤销了修改文件的暂存状态。新文件仍已暂存，所以此次提交只包含 8 个新文件的完整工作版本。为避免重现，应在从 origin 更新后再暂存。如果在暂存后执行更新，请告知我，我会先检查索引。

key: Plume trail performance optimizations and fixes for large numbers of trail segments and some edge cases: Change the method used for the first stage of coarse segment culling to a more appropriate one, this helps performance when rendering more than 10k trail segments. Fix issue where some plume segments can survive past their lifetime, while being invisible, and continue being carried by wind and splitting into smaller segments, causing a big performance hit. This addresses two big bottlenecks, some bottlenecks remain in the volume cache building and the plume shadow cascades which still need to be addressed for better performance at scale.
english: Plume trail performance optimizations and fixes for large numbers of trail segments and some edge cases: Change the method used for the first stage of coarse segment culling to a more appropriate one, this helps performance when rendering more than 10k trail segments. Fix issue where some plume segments can survive past their lifetime, while being invisible, and continue being carried by wind and splitting into smaller segments, causing a big performance hit. This addresses two big bottlenecks, some bottlenecks remain in the volume cache building and the plume shadow cascades which still need to be addressed for better performance at scale.
chinese: 优化大量尾焰轨迹分段的性能并修复边缘情况。改用更合适的第一阶段粗剔除方法，提升渲染超过 10k 个轨迹分段时的性能。修复部分不可见分段超过寿命后仍被风带动并持续细分、导致性能大幅下降的问题。两处主要瓶颈已处理，体积缓存构建和尾焰阴影级联仍有优化空间。
notes: Translated from the installed 5801 changelog, keyed by the exact body text. Revision, date and author are rendered unchanged.

key: Updated aerodynamic meshing to take into account thin plates (shapes thin in only one dimension). If a volume is completely enclosed within thin shapes, that area now becomes an aerodynamic solid. If there is an unclosed area of plates large enough to be aerodynamically relevant, they become freestanding zero-depth aerodynamic walls or fins.
english: Updated aerodynamic meshing to take into account thin plates (shapes thin in only one dimension). If a volume is completely enclosed within thin shapes, that area now becomes an aerodynamic solid. If there is an unclosed area of plates large enough to be aerodynamically relevant, they become freestanding zero-depth aerodynamic walls or fins.
chinese: 更新气动网格生成，使其考虑仅在一个维度上很薄的板件。薄板完全围合的空间视为气动实体，足以影响气动的未闭合板组则视为独立的零厚度气动壁或翼片。
